name: Language and package version identity remains stable across releases

applicability.reason: Supported. C025 freezes public stable hash mappings for specification-stable values within one language major, and C027 makes a minor or patch release sharing (package_id, api_major) PRESERVE nominal Type identity. Both are observable across a real upgrade: the fixture records a Type hash and a value hash, performs an explicit same-major upgrade, and both compare equal afterwards while the VERSION moves 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 and the package identity stays (org.iris.v912, 1). The version move is what makes the equality meaningful rather than vacuous - it shows the upgrade actually happened and identity survived it, rather than nothing having occurred.
